what_changes: After two fabric-A baseline rounds, rank 2's worker-side A egress qdisc changes to 20 Mbit/s while remaining UP; the detector reads the distinct switch-facing peer, then the deterministic host gate and all-rank versioned handover to healthy fabric B run.
expected: One degraded fabric-A round exposes the fault, Layer 1 and Layer 2 confirm it, all four ranks commit version 1 for the next safe round, and subsequent fabric-B throughput retains at least 90% of baseline with zero mixed-version or checksum errors.
